note: Block materials a sculpture may use. A block stores the numeric material id; the role names are how generators ask for one, and the plugin maps each role to the id in its MaterialIds config, so a wrong id is fixed in the server config without rebuilding. Ids 1-9 come from a third-party server plugin (evidence in plugins/docs/RealmSculptor.md) and are UNVERIFIED on our server until /sculpt materials has written the real table. previewColour is a guess at each material's unpainted look for the 'unpainted' preview. colourable stays null until the in-game dump says which materials take paint.
